h1: Zimbabwe tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Zimbabwe? This page explains the Zimbabwe tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Zimbabwe tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Zimbabwe. You can apply online for an eVisa before travelling, or get a visa on arrival.

sections.heading: What a Zimbabwe tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Zimbabwe tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Zimbabwe. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Zimbabwe business visa](/zimbabwe-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply in advance, depending on their nationality. If you're also visiting Zambia, ask us whether the KAZA visa is available for your trip.

sections.heading: Zimbabwe tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Zimbabwe tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Zimbabwe.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Zimbabwe tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Zimbabwe tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Zimbabwe on a Zimbabwe tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Zimbabwe tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
